# common one (the name stock_exchange_name, the icon).

	if = { limit = { has_building = building_financial_centre_swe } owner = { set_variable = { name = zz_ef_fc_variant value = flag:swe } } }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_financial_centre_swi } owner = { set_variable = { name = zz_ef_fc_variant value = flag:swi } } }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_financial_centre_tus } owner = { set_variable = { name = zz_ef_fc_variant value = flag:tus } } }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_financial_centre_tur } owner = { set_variable = { name = zz_ef_fc_variant value = flag:tur } } }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_financial_centre_uru } owner = { set_variable = { name = zz_ef_fc_variant value = flag:uru } } }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_financial_centre_usa } owner = { set_variable = { name = zz_ef_fc_variant value = flag:usa } } }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_financial_centre_sax } owner = { set_variable = { name = zz_ef_fc_variant value = flag:sax } } }
}
